/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import re
class Validate(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True);self.stack=[];self.ids=[];self.links=[];self.details=0;self.h1=0
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='a' and a.get('href','').startswith('#') and len(a['href'])>1:self.links.append(a['href'][1:])
  if tag=='details':self.details+=1
  if tag=='h1':self.h1+=1
  if tag not in {'area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'}:self.stack.append(tag)
 def handle_endtag(self,tag):
  assert self.stack and self.stack[-1]==tag, f'Bad nesting: {tag} after {self.stack[-3:]}'
  self.stack.pop()
 def handle_startendtag(self,tag,attrs):pass
s=Path('index.html').read_text();p=Validate();p.feed(s)
assert not p.stack,p.stack
assert len(set(p.ids))==len(p.ids)
assert not set(p.links)-set(p.ids),set(p.links)-set(p.ids)
assert p.details==5 and p.h1==1
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion:reduce' in s
assert '<img' not in s and 'url(http' not in s
css=re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>',s,re.S)[1]
assert css.count('{')==css.count('}')
def lum(h):
 vals=[int(h[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (1,3,5)]
 vals=[v/12.92 if v<=.04045 else ((v+.055)/1.055)**2.4 for v in vals]
 return sum(v*w for v,w in zip(vals,(.2126,.7152,.0722)))
for label,fg,bg in [('Body text','#1d3028','#f8f9f5'),('Secondary text','#5d6962','#f8f9f5'),('Primary button','#ffffff','#315c45'),('Dark section secondary text','#b6c5ba','#1d3028')]:
 a,b=sorted([lum(fg),lum(bg)]);ratio=(b+.05)/(a+.05);assert ratio>=4.5;print(label+': '+str(round(ratio,2))+':1')
print('Passed: HTML nesting, unique IDs, all local anchor destinations, five native FAQ disclosures, responsive/reduced-motion CSS, and key color contrast.')
print('Output files:', ', '.join(p.name for p in Path('.').iterdir() if p.is_file()))
PY"
